headline: Heritage Automotive expansion at 1580 and 1620 Shelburne Road continued to December 1 after a nearby school raised truck and speeding concerns.
summary: The project adds a 17,862 sq ft addition to the building at 1600 Shelburne Road and replaces a 14,808 sq ft building at 30 Green Mountain Drive with a 3,721 sq ft building. Public speakers said trucks unloading on Green Mountain Drive block part of the road during school drop-off and pick-up. The board asked the applicant to explain next time why unloading happens on the street. The board also closed hearings on Beta Technologies at 430 Davinci Drive and Negley & Chase Construction at 596 Meadowland Drive.
decisions: Motion carried to close the hearing on Beta Technologies' site plan at 430 Davinci Drive.
Motion carried to close the hearing on Negley & Chase Construction's group home project at 596 Meadowland Drive.
Motion carried to continue the Heritage Automotive Group amendment to December 1.
discussion: Truck unloading on the street: Public speakers said semi-trailers unload on Green Mountain Drive three to four times a week, blocking half the road during school drop-off and pick-up. The board asked the applicant to explain next time why unloading happens on the street.

Speeding in the school zone: Public speakers said technicians test cars on Green Mountain Drive, sometimes reaching 45 to 50 mph, and that employees leaving at 5:00 p.m. often speed through the school zone.

Display and employee parking areas: Members discussed marking which spaces are for vehicle display only. A condition was proposed that the applicant mark the display area, subject to review by the administrative officer.

Meadowland Drive trail plans: The applicant proposed signed trails, with 5-ft brush-hogged trails outside the wetland buffer and primitive trails inside it. The board discussed a possible condition that the trails be brush-hogged for the first 5 years.

Transfer development rights waiver: The applicant asked the board to waive the full transfer development rights needed to add height at 430 Davinci Drive for flight simulators. The building would be 57 ft high; 50 ft is allowed without the rights and 78 ft with them.
